name: SSO-OIDC-Secure-RBAC
description: Advanced OIDC authentication with role-based library access control
overview: OpenID Connect SSO with granular role-to-library mapping, multi-provider support, and a full admin configuration UI.

versions.changelog: Security: validate JWT tokens against IdP JWKS endpoint; pin discovery endpoints on first use (TOFU) with mismatch detection; enforce nonce on all tokens; prevent XSS in login button output; per-provider strict access token validation toggle. Fix: redirect_uri resolves correctly behind reverse proxies via GetSmartApiUrl. Rebrand as SSO-OIDC-Secure-RBAC with new plugin GUID.
Remove unsafe display name sync: fallback lookup by display name risks matching wrong users; disable in UI pending Jellyfin upstream ExternalSubjectId support
